title: The Fever Wards
text: A grey fever runs house by house through the tanners' quarter, and each morning the carts go out full. The sick sweat ink. The physicians say the stains on their sheets make the same shape again and again, whoever the sleeper: a door, standing a little open.

temptation.label: Sell the physicians' herbs to the highest bidder.
temptation.text: Your steward knows a buyer upriver who pays silver for the herbs. He would take the sheets as well.

triumph.text: The fever breaks within the month. The ink-stained sheets are burned in the square.

holds.text: The quarter is barricaded until the fever starves inside it. Some of the healthy starve with it.

falters.text: The fever reaches the Houses' halls. Someone draws doors on every pillow.

calamity.text: For a season the dead are burned in the squares. Their smoke draws doors across the sky.
